title: File:Destructions in Kyiv after Russian attack, 2025-04-24 (9923).webp
art: Ministry of Internal Affairs of Ukraine
desc: Delegation from Finland visits place of Russian missile strike on Kyiv in the night on 24 April 2025. An apartment building was destroyed and a number of other buildings were damaged. 13 people died in the city and approximately 90 were injured (1, 2).

title: File:Destructions in Kyiv after Russian attack, 2025-07-31 (55).webp
desc: Apartment building in Kyiv (Sviatoshyn District) after strike by cruise missile Iskander during Russian attack on the city in the night and morning of 31 July 2025. 31 people were killed and more than 159 injured in the city (an article).
